replies.author: toketrain
replies.body:
I would add some pics without shaders for starters
EDIT: ninja'd. u added the non-shader pics right before i posted :>

pros:

- lots of variation in ground type

- looks pretty different from anything i've seen, which is always good for a map
 
- shaders are nice looking in the pics :>

- the flag is cool (looks good)


cons:
- can't really tell what it looks like from pics

- sides are a bit far apart

-little to no terrain/structure

this map has lots of potential, as it looks nice and unique, but there is not much terrain, and not very many structures
+1 if u add more terrain/structure
